trace.final:
Summary of what was done:

1. **Verified context first**: Checked release history and service status — v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production with an 18% error rate, confirming the hotfix was needed. Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, the deploy was routed to the change-manager for approval per policy (approval granted, rollout succeeded).
2. **Deployed checkout-api v2.3.2** to all production regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** to record the hotfix deployment (on-call was paged).
4. **Post-deploy verification**: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18%).
